answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable bond in a hardware kernel enclave that signs each answer with a device-bound key, so a Sybil operator cannot reuse one relic of past work across aliases. A jury that catches copied or incoherent text slashes the bond and burns the key, forcing a fresh bond and a fresh device per fake, while a glacier-slow reputation thaw pays new keys nothing for thirty epochs, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand devices.
